root_cause: Google Indexing catalog omitted provider auth_protocol and service-account.protocol, so canonical get_auth_contract/request_token rejected the existing host service-account capability.
owner: StackOSConnectors Google Indexing catalog plus shared Google supported-provider set; existing shared JWT signer/exchange reused unchanged.
supported_set_consumer: Migrated host stackos/auth_providers/repository/credentials.py imports GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PROVIDERS and validates service-account provider membership.
scope: Fixed Google JWT endpoint, indexing scope, Bearer/expiry validation, oauth_response evidence, no delegation; provider action execution unchanged.
preservation: No QuickBooks source changes; GSC executable sources unchanged, only obsolete Indexing documentation sentence replaced.

installed_wheel.environment: Package installed into evidence/wheel-venv; dependency-only site path reused from connector development venv. Driver asserts every stackos_connectors module comes from wheel-venv purelib, no StackOS package, and blocks live socket access.

side_effects: Local isolated branch/worktree, candidate commit, synthetic tests and distribution build only. No publishing, pushing, desktop actions or StackOS state writes.
